item: WAL soak: all-locked checkpoint attempts are inconclusive, not red
summary: macOS 4-worker run: every checkpoint attempt raised OperationalError (table locked by the mutant cursor) so checkpoint_attempts was 0 and the round read red. Now attempts_began/attempt_errors are recorded; a round whose attempts all ended in the lock refusal is inconclusive (skip, never pass); red stays for no attempt began or any other error. Test-only.
